questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

Some of my burden __have being__ reduced.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'has been'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the underlined segment, the **form of the verb "have being''** is **incorrect**.
 
• The use of the **plural form of the verb 'have'** with the **singular subject 'my burden'** is **incorrect**.
 
• The **singular form of the verb 'has'** should be used **in place of** the **plural verb 'have'**.
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense of the passive voice**.
 
• The **passive format** for the **present perfect tense** is "**has/have + been+ V3 (reduced)**''.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *Some of my burden **has been** reduced*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

The police wrongly charged an innocent man of murder.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'of murder'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of **the** preposition "of'' is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'of' expresses **the relationship of a part of something to its whole**.
 
• The **preposition 'of'** should be **replaced by** the **preposition 'with'**.
 
• The **preposition 'with' **means **‘accompanied by’ something or someone**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Sentence: *The police wrongly charged an innocent man **with murder***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, ''of'' preposition का उपयोग गलत है ।
 
• Preposition 'of’ किसी चीज के एक हिस्से के रिश्ते को उसके संपूर्ण रूप से व्यक्त करता है।
 
• 'Of' पूर्वसर्ग 'with' पूर्वसर्ग द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• 'With' का अर्थ है 'कुछ या किसी के साथ'.

 

इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है ।

सही सजा: *The police wrongly charged an innocent man with murder*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

He asked __from me that__ I had gone to school or not.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'me whether'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the preposition 'from' is **superfluous,** and the use of the **preposition 'that'** is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'from' is used for **indicating separation or removal**.
 
• Therefore, the preposition 'from' is unnecessary in the sentence and should be removed.
 
• Also, the** conjunction 'that'** used in the sentence is **incorrect**.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is used **for introducing a subordinate clause expressing a statement or hypothesis**.
 
• The conjunction 'whether' is used for **expressing a doubt or choice between alternatives**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct Sentence: *He asked **me whether** I had gone to school or not*.

• In **Passive Voice,** a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.

• When we convert this sentence into **passive voice, **the **subject** **'you'** of the active voice **becomes** the **object**, **the object 'the parcel' becomes** the **subject**.

• This is the active and passive voice **rule **for the **past simple tense.**

Hence, the correct answer is option 4*.*
